reason: This is a definitional difference, not a wrong value. The app's 6.03 is yfinance trailingEps, which is FY26 continuing-ops net income divided by WEIGHTED-AVERAGE shares. That is the statutory Ind AS 33 basic-EPS basis. Screener's 5.62 is net profit divided by YEAR-END shares (7,859,600). Reconstruction: 5,759,600 pre-IPO shares plus 2,100,000 IPO shares weighted from late-June 2025 allotment (about 274/365 of FY26) gives about 7.34M shares, and 44,216,000 / 7.34M = 6.03 exactly. The 'does not self-reconcile' point (43.5M / 7.86M = 5.54) is the same period-end-denominator confusion. Per PROMPT_data_s2 a definitional difference is never a finding. At most a low polish item: the EPS basis (weighted vs period-end) is not labelled.

reason: Real, but the finding overstates it. The results-calendar service is NSE-only by construction: nse_provider.get_results_calendar has no BSE lane, unlike get_shareholding, which has NSE+BSE lanes. So every BSE-only name gets a 502 with the misleading 'not a known NSE instrument' text, and the live stack reproduces this. Two corrections take it from high to medium. First, the route serves board-meeting and results DATES (purpose/date events), not results figures, so 'cannot surface ANY results data' is wrong. The half-year figures the finding cites as outside truth are a different field, and the pack records the filing dates themselves as a world gap. Second, the failure is loud, not silent. Its only other consumer, research/disclosures.fetch_results_calendar, degrades softly to ok:false.

reason: Holds, and it is structural rather than ICON-specific. bse_provider._quote_from_header reads h.get('Volume') or h.get('TotalTradedQty'), but BSE's getScripHeaderData payload carries neither key: the Header object has PrevClose/Open/High/Low/LTP/Ason and no volume at all. So EVERY header-path BSE quote ships volume=null, even though the bhavcopy fallback (_quote_from_bhavcopy) carries real volume. Side observation for the lead: the live quote is stamped timestamp 2026-09-23 via most_recent_session, while BSE's own 'Ason' says 22 Sep 26 16:00, so the session label also ignores the header's as-of.

reason: The gap is real but the mechanism is misdescribed and the severity overstated. dividend_per_share_ttm is a DERIVED field that /fundamentals never computes: it is excluded from field_meta stamping, and the cited 'provider did not publish' meta at collected:377-383 belongs to dividend_per_share, not _ttm. The research FAST leg fills it via dividend_history, which deliberately returns 'unavailable' for an EMPTY dividend series, because never-paid and data-missing cannot be told apart from that alone. So a lifetime non-payer like ICON is shown as honestly-labelled unknown, never as the confirmed 0. That is a conservative design choice with a reason attached, not a silent blank, so the severity goes to low. The fix is to affirm zero when price history covers 12 months or more and the dividend series is empty.

reason: The app does not corrupt anything. BSE's own AnnSubCategoryGetData payload has the literal double quote in NEWSSUB (' Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Scrutinizer"s Report'), and in the long HEADLINE it even has doubled single quotes ('Scrutinizer''s'). corporate_disclosures._clean only strips whitespace, so the app faithfully reproduces the exchange's text of record. Screener shows a normalized rendering. There is no app-side mis-transliteration.
